1476968561019846799.name: Report Bug
1476968561019846799.content: Before reporting a bug, please make sure you have a valid error from the console. You can open the console by pressing F9 on PC or by typing /console in the chat on mobile. If there are no errors shown in the console, I won't be able to investigate or entertain the report.

1530317865423605962.name: Macro
1530317865423605962.content: Use /macro to upload your macro JSON and generate a shareable link. Your message will be automatically deleted after a few seconds. Copy the generated link and paste it into the script.
